verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe retrieved an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document without authentication at /openapi/mesh-api.json, covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at guessed conventional paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at a different documented URL. Missing for 10: the spec is not discoverable at standard well-known/openapi.json paths, and docs on the download (location, versioning of the spec file) are thin.
